The applicant has been arrested on 02.04.2023 by Police Station Aron, District Guna (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.06/2023, registered in relation to the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376(2)(N), 506(2) of IPC and 5/6 POCSO Act.

sentences.text: As per prosecution case, the allegations levelled against the applicant is that the applicant abducted the prosecutrix and committed rape with her.
It is submitted by Counsel for the applicant that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the above case.

Learned counsel for the applicant has invited the attention of this Court to the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of CrPC whereas she had admitted that she had gone with the applicant of her own free will and volition.
There is no direct or indirect evidence available on record.
He is in custody since 02.04.2023.
After conclusion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed, therefore, no further custodial interrogation is required.
It is submitted that the trial is likely to take sufficiently long time to complete.
There is no likelihood that the applicant may temper with the prosecution evidence or he may flee away from justice.
On these grounds he prayed for grant of bail.

Learned Public Prosecutor for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection by contending that on the basis of the allegations and the material available on record, no case for grant of bail is made out.

In wake of the statements of prosecutrix under Section 164 of CrPC, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rs. One Lac Only) with two solvent sureties each to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court.

This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the petitioner :-
1.

The petitioner will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial; and 6 . The petitioner will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.
7. The petitioner shall mark his attendance before the concerned police station once a week till filing of charge-sheet.
